facts.text: Deborah takes runs in the park every morning and evening.

evidence.quote: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.

facts.text: Deborah finds peace in nature every day.

evidence.quote: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!

facts.text: Jolene expresses a desire to experience running in nature every day.

evidence.quote: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.

facts.text: Jolene mentions that her snakes do not run and would motivate her if they did.

evidence.quote: It's a pity that my snakes don't run! I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
